## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Mechanics Focus"}
The base assignment compares direct axial stress in an aligned hanger region with combined axial and bending stress in an eccentric region. Local stresses at bends and pin holes, fatigue, vibration, and carriage dynamics are intentionally excluded.
:::
